_metadata.description: Per-version JSON examples that drive catalog previews, specimen galleries, CLI/API queries, and experience-component reconciliation.

requirements.title: Version folders may declare data-only component examples
requirements.description: Each component version may include `examples.json` beside the TSX source. Examples are pure JSON with stable `name`, optional display label, JSON `props`, optional `setup`, and optional `expect[]` assertions. Non-serializable React values use the documented `$` vocabulary and are resolved only inside the preview harness.

validation.notes: Proves `examples.json` is parsed from version folders and indexed as component_examples rows. Verified passing 2026-07-14.
Invalid examples emit non-fatal findings rather than dropping otherwise valid component metadata. Verified passing 2026-07-14.

requirements.title: Examples are queryable through API and CLI
requirements.description: `ComponentsService.ListComponentExamples` exposes indexed examples by component id and optional version. The CLI command `react-component-library components examples <component-id>` is a thin Connect-RPC wrapper with human output and `--json` support.

validation.notes: CLI test proves component id/version forwarding and rendered examples output. Verified passing 2026-07-14. (Requirement remains in_progress pending the live-round-trip manual check below.)
Live round trip during Phase 5: `react-component-library components examples <Button id> --version 1.2.0 --json` returned the seeded `primary` example after reindex.

requirements.title: Specimen gallery renders every named example and checks expectations
requirements.description: The component editor preview mode renders one harness iframe per indexed example for the selected version. The harness resolves `$text`, `$node`, `$icon`, `$handler`, `$rowKey`, `$columns`, and `$filters`, then evaluates `expect[]` assertions after render and reports failures through the existing preview-error channel.

validation.ref: ui/src/features/components/ComponentEditor.test.tsx::renders example gallery iframes with named harness URLs
validation.notes: UI test proves the gallery emits named harness URLs for indexed examples.
`pnpm run test:preview-e2e` passed across all 11 catalog components and their example frames during Phase 6.

requirements.title: Generated docs can be derived from prop types
requirements.description: A future documentation generator can combine component prop metadata, named examples, and version metadata into Storybook-style reference pages without changing the examples data contract.

validation.notes: Future docs-generation tests should parse prop metadata and render reference docs for at least one component with multiple named examples.
